children.name: Physena madagascariensis Steud.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Madagascar. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Physena sessiliflora Tul.
children.description: The native range of this species is W. & S. Madagascar. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
